product_one_liner.value: DataGrail automates data discovery, consent management, privacy requests, assessments and risk management for privacy, legal and security teams.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page or pricing navigation link was found; the pricing URL returned no page. Solution pages discuss custom packaging but do not present pricing plans.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 73 employees as of September 30, 2026.

eng_blog.notes: Technical engineering articles cover REST API integration design and Python property-based testing; the latter is published under the company byline.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists four openings; none has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

compliance_certs.notes: The page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA compliance and GDPR compliance; HIPAA and GDPR are compliance claims, not standalone certifications.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest reported round was October 12, 2022, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live board lists four openings, none matching SDR, BDR or account executive. The previously indexed Mid Market Account Executive URL now redirects to the current board.

launched_6mo.notes: On June 24, 2026, DataGrail announced automatic detection and inventory of shadow MCP systems connected to Claude, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Lauren Volpi’s profile dates the end of her DataGrail CMO tenure to January 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The demand-generation posting describes an existing HubSpot instance and Salesforce sync. Marketo and Pardot are listed as desired experience, not evidence of deployment.
